designs.U0: Exact H7 R0 main-effect pairwise Ridge baseline
designs.U1: Same main effects and Ridge head plus16 train-only KMeans RBF prototype similarities

failure_semantics: Any failed fold remains explicit; incomplete designs have null macro and unavailable paired comparison
head: H7 R0 Ridge with the identical pair generation, family/system weights, normalization, alpha grid and seed
inner_objective: AUC separately in every inner validation fold x family with both P and U. Equally average valid-fold AUCs within each training family, then equally average all three training families. An alpha is invalid if any training family has no valid fold. Choose largest alpha within 0.01 AUC of best. Never compare scores across inner models; all transformations and term expansion fit inside each training fold.
label_semantics: P: an original MP parent with an observed positive SuperCon descendant; U: no positive descendant recorded in this snapshot, not measured nonsuperconducting.
metrics: Equal-family recall at20% ranking budget with fractional ties

optional_snapshot.hash_rule: Exact original bytes; no parsing before checksum validation
optional_snapshot.source: H7 CI66 input-parents.csv, same frozen615-parent cohort

outer: Leave each family out; remove its chemical systems from all supervised and auxiliary training.

paired_bootstrap.conditioning: Fixed exploratory predictions; does not undo previous inspection or model selection
paired_bootstrap.unit: chemical-system clusters across all held families

pairs.weights: Equal eligible training families, then equal eligible positive chemical systems (bootstrap system multiplicities respected), then equal eligible positive rows. Uniformly sample up to four distinct eligible unlabeled systems and one row per system; bootstrap multiplicity weights the system draw.

prototype_head_scale: H7 train-only linear TermBasis scale applied to baseline main-effect columns and prototype similarities; no interaction terms
publication: All designs reported; no automatic winner selection or model release. Families were inspected previously; not a new blind test.

representation.background: None: no held-family, test, calibration, auxiliary JARVIS or external foundation-model rows
representation.degenerate: Only distinct informative training vectors fit active prototypes; pad to16 with explicit inactive zero columns; all-constant or all-missing yields no active prototype
representation.feature: exp(-squared Euclidean distance / (2 sigma^2)) to each train-only prototype
representation.input: Unlabeled physical X of corresponding training parents only, restricted to the identical main-effect columns eligible in H7 R0; not P/U labels
representation.interpretation: Unsupervised material similarity; cluster membership does not establish mechanism or superconductivity
representation.preprocessing: Training median imputation, training mean/std, remove all-missing/constant columns, z clip at5; no missing indicators
representation.sigma: Median strictly positive training distance to nearest prototype;1 scaled-unit fallback if all distances zero
